visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a sequence showing an astronaut in a white pressurized suit floating in space. A robotic arm and technical components are visible in the foreground, with the curved edge of Earth and the black void of space behind. (2) A 2D cartoon male character with dark hair and a gray shirt appears against a solid red background, pointing one finger upward in an explanatory gesture. (3) A cinematic shot reveals an astronaut floating high above the blue and white swirling clouds of Earth. A close-up shows the reflection of the planet in the astronaut's visor. (4) Aerial views of Earth at night show sprawling golden city lights interconnected by dark landmasses. This is followed by a full view of the blue planet rotating slowly in the dark. (5) A female astronaut with dark hair, wearing a blue flight suit with NASA patches, is interviewed in a bright studio. She talks with expressive facial movements and hand gestures. (6) Visuals intercut her interview: the 'thin blue line' of the atmosphere, night landscapes, and vivid green auroras seen from orbit. (7) Final shots show a full Earth through a curved spacecraft window, emphasizing its isolation in space.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 维阿维. [Slogan]: 從宇宙看地球會改變人生觀？. (2) [Slogan]: 太空人回地球後更善良？ [Subtitle]: 你聽說過嗎？. (3) [Logo]: @SpaceverseHQ. [Subtitle]: 當太空人在宇宙看到地球時. (4) [Slogan]: 全景效應 OVERVIEW EFFECT. 總觀效應 OVERVIEW EFFECT. (5) [Subtitle]: 當透過圓頂窗戶，就像一扇大窗. [Subtitle]: 向下俯瞰地球. [Subtitle]: 看到地球與背後廣闊的宇宙共存. [Subtitle]: 你會看到大氣層那條纖細的藍線. [Subtitle]: 當你處於地球的暗面時. [Subtitle]: 還能看到一條非常纖細的綠線. [Subtitle]: 標示出大氣層的邊界. [Subtitle]: 這時你會意識到. [Subtitle]: 你認識的每個人都在這條綠線內生存. [Subtitle]: 而綠線外的一切都無法生存. [Subtitle]: 你不再看到國界、宗教分界或政治邊界. [Subtitle]: 你只看到了地球. [Subtitle]: 你會發現，我們的相似之處遠遠多過不同.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A calm, informative male voice speaks in Mandarin Chinese, introducing the 'Overview Effect'. A soft, atmospheric ambient electronic music bed plays underneath, featuring a subtle, mid-tempo synth pulse. (2) The female voice of an astronaut speaking in English is introduced. The Mandarin male voice continues at a slightly lower volume, acting as a simultaneous translator. (3) The female speaker uses a warm, professional, and slightly awe-filled tone to describe seeing Earth. (4) A gentle electronic whoosh sound effect signals a transition between interview and footage. The BGM maintains a steady, contemplative tone with shimmering high-frequency textures and a solid low-end foundation. (5) The voices and music remain well-balanced, ending with a final narrative statement in Mandarin over fading music.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Concept Introduction -> Expert Testimony -> Philosophical Conclusion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To educate the audience on the 'Overview Effect,' a psychological shift in perspective experienced by astronauts, and to promote global unity and environmental protection by viewing Earth as a single, fragile entity.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video utilizes a high-quality interview with a real astronaut (Nicole Stott) to provide credibility, paired with visually stunning space footage to evoke an emotional response.
